# Method (same as sweep): L = PIL grey 0-255. Old-ink mask = ORIGINAL L < 0.60 x 21px median AND max channel |v002-orig| > 12 -> reproduces the sweep exactly on v002 in strip 446,316,466,383 (176 old-ink px, minL 14, median 24). ghost_px = old-ink px < 0.85 x local skin (local skin = per-px median of current L in a 31x31 window, excluding old ink dilated 2 and the strap/hair column x<449). Outline step = mean Sobel |grad| (gauss 0.7) on old-ink outline px vs skin ring 2-6 px off the old ink. Null test = mean 5x-high-pass (C - gauss sigma 2) and L/gauss6 ratio on old-ink px vs the same mask shifted 6-9 px (17-23 shifts, skin x>=449) -> delta, z. Visual: 4x and 6x plain, autocontrast, 5x high-pass, with original ink edge overlaid. CAVEAT: the sweep's per-pixel skin ring and tile-z definitions are not fully specified in its header, so absolute <0.85 counts / z differ from the sweep's (38 px, z -3..-5); every number below is computed with ONE definition on orig, v002 and v006 so they are comparable to each other.
